scripts.setup: npm run sync:haapi-version && npm install && EXPO_NONINTERACTIVE=1 npm run build && cd example && npm install
scripts.setup:ios: npm run setup && cd example/ios && rm -rf Pods Podfile.lock build && pod install --repo-update
scripts.setup:android: npm run setup && cd example/android && ./gradlew clean
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && cd example/ios && rm -rf Pods Podfile.lock build && pod install --repo-update && cd ../android && ./gradlew clean
scripts.setup:ios:native: npm run setup && cd ios && xcodegen generate && pod install
scripts.test:ios:native: npm run setup:ios:native && cd ios && xcodebuild test -workspace IdsvrHaapiReactNativeSdk.xcworkspace -scheme RNIdsvrHaapiSdk -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,OS=latest,name=iPhone 17'
scripts.run:ios: npm run setup:ios && cd example && npx expo run:ios
scripts.run:android: npm run setup:android && cd example && npx expo run:android
scripts.run:all: npm run setup:all && cd example && npx expo run:ios && npx expo run:android
